_comment: Pinned SHA-256 checksums for each platform's supervisor binary, for the version below. Generated and committed by .github/workflows/release-supervisor.yml on every supervisor release tag — never hand-edited. binary-resolver.ts refuses to download+trust a binary for any platform missing an entry here, rather than falling back to an unverified download. See docs/rules/13-local-worker-and-distribution.md §10.
